suppressions.reason: This read serves three sort orders from one statement, so its ORDER BY is a set of conditional expressions rather than columns. No index can order rows by an expression that switches on a bound parameter, and the advisor correctly declines to propose one. Splitting it into three statements to make each one index-ordered would trade a sort of one list's to-dos for three copies of the same filter logic.

The sort is over the result of a two-join fan-out, not over a single table, so no index on Tag can supply the order. Both joined tables are already index searches, and the sorted set is the tags of one list.
The same shape as tags-for-list, for one to-do rather than one list. Both joined tables are already index searches, and a to-do carries a handful of tags.
